xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4467: Conflict repair skips an approved PR silently once its head moved past the approval (PR #4440 stuck CONFLICTING)

plan.title: Conflict repair skips an approved PR silently once its head moved past the approval (PR #4440 stuck CONFLICTING)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: An approved PR whose head moved past the approval (the agent merged main and pushed without re-requesting review) and that then turns CONFLICTING has no route out. evaluateConflictRepairGate requires approval at head, so it answers conflicting:false; tickIssue then runs reviewBackstop, which returns null because the PR is not mergeable; and tickIssue never logs the gate's reason. PR #4440 (PAN-4433) sat CONFLICTING for about 13 hours with zero [conflict-repair] log lines.
narratives.Proposal: Treat a GitHub stale approval (facts.approved true, approval not proven at head) as repair-eligible in evaluateConflictRepairGate and report it as staleApproval:true. The patrol sends one sync-main repair per head as today; the prompt's first line says the PR was approved at an older commit and the conflict.repair-requested journal entry carries data.staleApproval:true. Nothing merges on it: the merge gate still needs approval at the repaired head, the prompt demands pan review request, requestReviewGuarded proceeds on a stale approval, and the review backstop re-requests review. Separately, tickIssue logs a declined conflicting head (open, mergeable:false) once per issue and head. Docs in PIPELINE-GATES.md and MERGE-WORKFLOW.md describe both.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Do not repair a PR whose approval was dismissed on the forge (facts.approved false) even if the journal says APPROVED; it is only logged.
- Do not route the mergeable stale-approval deadlock (approved at an older head, PR mergeable, no review request, no prior repair entry); that is a separate follow-up issue.
- Do not change evaluateIssueMergeGate, evaluateMergeReadiness, isConflictRepairCandidate, reviewBackstop, the grace/backstop timers, or the dashboard patrol host.
- Do not call recordApprovalAtHead from evaluateConflictRepairGate.
- Do not add a forge read, a journal entry type, or any persistent store for skip logs.
- Do not edit changelog.mdx.

autoDecisions.summary: Route a stale-approval conflicting PR to a sync-main repair rather than straight to Needs-you.
autoDecisions.rationale: The repair unblocks the PR, and re-review before merge is already guaranteed: the merge gate needs approval at the new head, the prompt's step 5 demands pan review request, requestReviewGuarded proceeds when readApprovalStandsAtHead is false, and reviewBackstop re-requests review. Needs-you is still reached through the existing grace and unreachable escalations.

autoDecisions.summary: This supersedes PAN-4451's non-goal 'Conflicting PRs whose approval does not stand at the head are not repaired'.
autoDecisions.rationale: PAN-4467 is the newer issue and explicitly asks for this route; PAN-4451 left it out assuming the agent's own review request would cover it, which PR #4440 disproved. Not a contradiction between authoritative inputs for one issue.

autoDecisions.summary: Stale approval = facts.forge === 'github' && facts.approved === true && approval not proven at head; dismissed approvals (facts.approved false) are not repaired, only logged.
autoDecisions.rationale: The forge is authoritative over the pipeline journal (CLAUDE.md). GitLab never sets approvedAtHead, so the forge check prevents mislabeling every GitLab repair as stale.

autoDecisions.summary: Skip-log dedup key is <ISSUE>:<head8>, in memory, re-logged once after a dashboard restart.
autoDecisions.rationale: The AC says once per issue and head; the module's existing refusalsSurfaced/lastBackstopAt dedup is in-memory and nothing is stored (Overdeck stores no derivable status).
